name: Security Monitoring Dashboard
description: Security events, threats, and compliance monitoring

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM SecurityEvent TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM SecurityThreatEvent TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago

SELECT average(securityPostureScore) FROM SecurityScore WHERE scoreCategory = 
\overall' SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT count(*) FROM SecurityEvent FACET severity SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM SecurityThreatEvent FACET threatType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = \success') FROM AuthenticationEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM SecurityEvent FACET category SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AuthenticationEvent WHERE result != \success' FACET ipLocation SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT eventType, severity, source, category, timestamp FROM SecurityEvent ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM SecurityViolation FACET policyType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT resource, action, userRole, count(*) FROM AuthorizationFailure SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT histogram(confidence, 10, 100) FROM SecurityThreatEvent FACET threatType SINCE 24 hours ago
